en.title: Iran nuclear envoy says uranium export refusal is permanent
en.dek: Iran's nuclear envoy states the country will not export enriched uranium, citing the US reward offer as the reason.
facts: Iran's nuclear envoy states the country will not export enriched uranium, citing the US reward offer as the reason.

Finland and Norway announced new restrictions against Russian athletes on 13 November 2026.

body: Iran's nuclear envoy stated on 13 November 2026 that the country will not export enriched uranium, citing the US reward offer as the reason, according to FAZ and The Straits Times.

Iran told the United Nations nuclear agency that monitoring cannot proceed while it is under threat, according to WPXI and SRF. Iran also rejected the resumption of nuclear inspections due to the current security situation.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy reported that a tanker carrying liquefied natural gas struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz on 13 November 2026, according to The Hindu and The Straits Times. The vessel suffered an explosion while traveling through the area, the reports stated.

Iran's military reported four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz on 12 November 2026, according to The Straits Times and DW.com. The vessels had ignored warnings and entered restricted areas, Iran stated.

Iranian state media reported that Sirik County and the Hormozgan province were hit by military strikes on 12 November 2026, according to Anadolu Ajansı and The Jerusalem Post. The reports described the incidents as strikes by an unnamed enemy.

Jared Kushner said on 13 November 2026 that the United States is working toward the largest prisoner exchange of the war in Ukraine, according to The Moscow Times and The New Arab. The exchange is currently in progress, the reports stated.

US envoys met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on 12 November 2026, following peace talks in Abu Dhabi, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Al Jazeera. President Donald Trump said on 12 November 2026 that he does not need a deal with Iran, according to the South China Morning Post and Axios.

Iran's top clerical governing body called for a review of nuclear doctrine on 12 November 2026, according to Iran International and Africanews. Mohsen Rezaei stated on 11 November 2026 that enriched nuclear material will not leave the country, according to Reuters and The Straits Times.
en.context: Iran's government condemned a US $20 million reward for information on its nuclear program on 11 November 2026, according to Daily Sabah. US envoys met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after peace talks in Abu Dhabi, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Al Jazeera.

en.context: Iran's government condemned a US $20 million reward for information on its nuclear program on 11 November 2026, according to Daily Sabah. US envoys met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after peace talks in Abu Dhabi, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Al Jazeera.

de.dek: Irans Nukleargesandter erklärt, das Land werde kein angereichertes Uran exportieren, und nennt das US-Belohnungsangebot als Grund.
body: Dem Iran zufolge kann die Überwachung durch die UN-Nuklearbehörde unter Androhung von Sanktionen oder Bedrohungen nicht fortgesetzt werden, wie WPXI und SRF berichteten. Der Iran lehnte zudem die Wiederaufnahme von Nuklearkontrollen aufgrund der gegenwärtigen Sicherheitslage ab.

Die IAEO erklärte am 13. November 2026 laut The Jerusalem Post und Ynetnews, sie kenne den genauen Standort oder Status der Büros der Urananreicherungsanlage in Isfahan nicht. Berichten zufolge ist unklar, ob die Anlage nukleares Material enthält.

Ein Tanker mit Flüssigerdgas sei am 13. November 2026 in der Straße von Hormus auf eine Seemine getroffen, berichteten The Hindu und The Straits Times unter Berufung auf die Marine der iranischen Revolutionsgarden. Das Schiff erlitt demnach während der Fahrt in diesem Gebiet eine Explosion.

Dem iranischen Militär zufolge wurden am 12. November 2026 vier Öltanker in der Straße von Hormus von Explosionen getroffen, wie The Straits Times und DW.com meldeten. Die Schiffe hätten Warnungen ignoriert und Sperrgebiete betreten, so der Iran.

Iranischen Staatsmedien zufolge wurden das Verwaltungsbezirk Sirik und die Provinz Hormozgan am 12. November 2026 von Militärschlägen getroffen, wie Anadolu Ajansı und The Jerusalem Post berichteten. Die Berichte bezeichneten die Vorfälle als Angriffe eines ungenannten Feindes.

Jared Kushner sagte am 13. November 2026 laut The Moscow Times und The New Arab, die Vereinigten Staaten arbeiteten auf den größten Gefangenenaustausch des Krieges in der Ukraine hin. Der Austausch sei derzeit im Gange.

US-Gesandte trafen sich am 12. November 2026 nach Friedensgesprächen in Abu Dhabi in Moskau mit dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin, wie Anadolu Ajansı und Al Jazeera berichteten. Präsident Donald Trump erklärte am 12. November 2026 laut der South China Morning Post und Axios, er benötige kein Abkommen mit dem Iran.

Irans oberstes Klerikalgremium forderte am 12. November 2026 eine Überprüfung der Nukleardoktrin, wie Iran International und Africanews berichteten. Mohsen Rezaei erklärte am 11. November 2026 laut Reuters und The Straits Times, angereichertes nukleares Material werde das Land nicht verlassen.

Rezaei also stated on 11 November 2026 that no negotiations are taking place between Tehran and Washington, according to Reuters and The Straits Times.

France 24 reported that Iran's security chief stated Tehran will strike US bases in Europe if those bases are used to attack Iran on 11 November 2026. The Straits Times reports Iran threatens Europe with attacks following the envoy's statement.

Iran's top clerical governing body called for a review of nuclear doctrine on 12 November 2026, according to Iran International and Africanews. Iranian state media reported that Sirik County and the Hormozgan province were hit by military strikes on Tuesday, according to Anadolu Ajansı and The Jerusalem Post.

Iran's military reported four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz on 12 November 2026, according to The Straits Times and DW.com. Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy reported that a tanker carrying liquefied natural gas struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz on 13 November, according to The Hindu and The Straits Times.

US envoys met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on 12 November 2026, following peace talks in Abu Dhabi, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Al Jazeera. President Donald Trump said on 12 November 2026 that he does not need a deal with Iran, according to the South China Morning Post and Axios.

US President Donald Trump stated on 12 November 2026 that he does not need a deal with Iran, according to reports by the South China Morning Post and Axios. Trump directed Vice President J.D. Vance to focus on domestic anti-fraud efforts rather than continuing negotiations with Iranian representatives.

Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated on 11 November 2026 that enriched nuclear material will not leave the country, according to Reuters and The Straits Times. Rezaei said that no talks were occurring between Tehran and Washington and warned that Iran would strike US military bases in Europe if those bases were used to attack Iranian territory.

Tehran will not move a single atom of enriched uranium from its territory, an Iranian official stated, according to The Washington Times. Daily Sabah and Yahoo Finance UK reported that the Iranian government condemned the US reward offer and rejected all foreign transfers of its nuclear stockpile.

Diplomatic developments also occurred elsewhere as US envoys met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow following peace talks in Abu Dhabi, according to Anadolu Ajansı and Al Jazeera. Concurrently, the European Parliament reported at least 20,651 confirmed cases of deported Ukrainian children, urging Russia to return them.
